specs.name: power
specs.source_sentence: The Thar's 2.0-litre turbo-petrol makes 152 PS and 320 Nm; the 2.2-litre diesel makes 132 PS with 300 Nm (source CarDekho).

specs.name: torque
specs.source_sentence: The Thar's 2.0-litre turbo-petrol makes 152 PS and 320 Nm; the 2.2-litre diesel makes 132 PS with 300 Nm (source CarDekho).

specs.name: engine_litre
specs.source_sentence: Engine options: a 2.0-litre turbo-petrol, a 1.5-litre diesel and a 2.2-litre diesel (source CarDekho).

specs.name: four_wheel_drive
specs.source_sentence: 4x4 (4WD) is available on the 2.2-litre diesel and 2.0-litre petrol variants; the base 1.5-litre diesel is rear-wheel drive (source CarDekho).
